name: 01773 · Lincoln, MA
findings: ZIP 01773 (Lincoln) has 72 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01773 (Lincoln) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 01773 (Lincoln) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.
